title: GDPR Compliance Policy Template - Free Download
metaDescription: Free GDPR compliance policy template for businesses. Includes all required sections, data processing guidelines, and privacy rights disclosures.
description: Comprehensive GDPR compliance policy template to help businesses meet EU data protection requirements. Covers data processing, user rights, cookies, and legal obligations with customizable sections for your organization.

sections.heading: Company Information and Data Controller Details
sections.content:
This section identifies your organization as the data controller and provides essential contact information for data protection inquiries.

[COMPANY_NAME] ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Data Controller Contact Information:
Company: [COMPANY_NAME]
Address: [COMPANY_ADDRESS]
Email: [CONTACT_EMAIL]
Data Protection Officer: [DPO_NAME] ([DPO_EMAIL])

sections.heading: Data We Collect and Legal Basis
sections.content:
We collect and process the following categories of personal data under these legal bases:

• Contact Information (name, email, phone): Collected for contract performance and legitimate interests
• Technical Data (IP address, browser type): Collected for legitimate interests in website functionality
• Usage Data (pages visited, time spent): Collected for legitimate interests in service improvement
• Marketing Preferences: Collected based on your consent
• [ADDITIONAL_DATA_TYPES]

We only process data that is necessary for the specified purposes and retain it only as long as required by law or business needs.

sections.heading: Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.content:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

• Right of Access: Request copies of your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a portable format
• Right to Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
• Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent for marketing communications

To exercise these rights, contact us at [PRIVACY_EMAIL]. We will respond within 30 days. For enhanced privacy protection, consider using a privacy-focused browser when accessing our services.

sections.heading: Data Sharing and International Transfers
sections.content:
We may share your personal data with:

• Service providers who process data on our behalf under strict contractual terms
• Legal authorities when required by law or to protect our rights
• [THIRD_PARTY_CATEGORIES]

International Transfers:
When transferring data outside the EU/EEA, we ensure adequate protection through:
• Adequacy decisions by the European Commission
• Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
• Binding Corporate Rules where applicable

We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.content:
Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to:

• Ensure essential website functionality (strictly necessary cookies)
• Analyze website performance and usage (analytics cookies)
• Provide personalized content and advertisements (targeting cookies)

Cookie Categories:
• Essential: Always active, cannot be disabled
• Analytics: Help us understand website usage (requires consent)
• Marketing: Used for targeted advertising (requires consent)

You can manage cookie preferences through our cookie banner or browser settings. Rejecting non-essential cookies will not affect core website functionality.

sections.heading: Data Security and Retention
sections.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data:

• Encryption of data in transit and at rest
• Regular security assessments and updates
• Access controls and staff training
• Incident response procedures

Data Retention Periods:
• Customer data: [CUSTOMER_RETENTION] after account closure
• Marketing data: Until consent is withdrawn or [MARKETING_RETENTION]
• Legal compliance data: As required by applicable laws
• Website analytics: [ANALYTICS_RETENTION]

We regularly review and securely delete data that is no longer needed.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Complaints
sections.content:
For any questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact us:

Email: [PRIVACY_EMAIL]
Address: [COMPANY_ADDRESS]
Phone: [PRIVACY_PHONE]

If you believe we have not handled your personal data properly, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority:

• In the UK: Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)
• In Ireland: Data Protection Commission (DPC)
• In Germany: Federal Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information
• Or your local EU data protection authority

This policy was last updated on [LAST_UPDATED] and may be revised to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws.
